# `console/css/tokens.css`

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Defines CSS design tokens (colors, typography, spacing, and sizes) shared across the console's stylesheets. Supports three color schemes reflecting the andon-board metaphor: a dark default scheme with painted-concrete floor and enameled-steel board, a light day scheme, and a darker night scheme.
